scope: Additive secure local factories and three-object private Compose renderer; unit source/shape evidence only

independentReview.result: Exact four-file source review closed. Complete factory/base Compose preservation, strict TLS settings, profile binding and unambiguous JSON checks are present.
independentReview.limits: Source review only; no tests, real NATS or Docker execution by the reviewer.

constraints: Legacy plain factories and renderer remain separate and unchanged.
Secure owner factory and renderer require material from the exact profile.
TLS configuration has exactly cert_file, key_file, Boolean handshake_first:true and min_version:1.3.
Duplicate/deep JSON, case aliases, weaker TLS, plaintext-first, automatic or duration fallback and extra TLS options are refused.
Private Compose has broker_config, server_cert and server_key inline objects with fixed root-owned 0400 references.
The CA signing key is never serialized or included; the renderer returns private bytes containing server key and passwords and must not be logged.
The launcher must bind and inspect the complete exact private bytes; inline injection does not remove Docker administrator access or export retention.
remaining: Confirm generated settings with the actual pinned disposable NATS2.15 parser and broker.
Verify health/read-only client TLS-first authentication and adversarial refusal before credentials.
Run the affected deployment suite on a stable complete slice.
Root owns installed profile/launcher binding, real Docker injection and supported-environment/phase acceptance.
